text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What could this be? It feels as though 
power is endlessly surging from deep 
within me—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Is it because I let my thoughts drift 
to history, I wonder? Or perhaps..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave behind a racing legacy too. One 
that will be spoken of for generations to 
come!
